Admin routes of the products module. Every route needs a staff session and the permission named on it; send `X-Resolve-Locale: false` to receive every locale of a translatable field for editing.

## GET /v1/admin/products

List all products (admin)

Parameters:

- `brand` in query (string, optional).
- `categoryId` in query (string, optional).
- `isFeatured` in query (boolean, optional).
- `page` in query (number, min 1, optional).
- `pageSize` in query (number, min 1, max 100, optional).
- `productTypeId` in query (string, optional).
- `search` in query (string, optional).
- `sortBy` in query (string, optional).

Responses:

- `200`: Products retrieved.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.
